name: app.proactiveparent/guidance
title: Proactive Parent guidance
description: Pregnancy and baby guidance by week or age: UK, US, Türkiye, general elsewhere. Not medical advice.

tools.name: week_guidance
tools.description: What happens in one week of pregnancy, for a family in any country (the UK, the US and Türkiye have their own guidance; every other country gets general guidance): the baby, the body, tips, and, where the region has them, the appointments and things to do that week. Our own written guidance, with the pages it drew on and links to official pages.

region.description: Where the family lives and gets care. GB: the United Kingdom. US: the United States. TR: Türkiye. INTL: general guidance for every other country, such as Germany, India or Brazil. Required, with no default, because care differs between countries: guidance is never taken from another region.

week.description: The week of pregnancy, counted from the first day of the last period (4 to 42).

language.description: The language to answer in. If the region's guidance is not written in it, the region's own language is used (GB and US: en; TR: tr; INTL: en, tr, es, fr).

tools.name: age_guidance
tools.description: What to expect at one age of a baby or young child (birth to 6 years), for a family in any country (the UK, the US and Türkiye have their own guidance; every other country gets general guidance): the week-by-week guide for the first year, the check-ups and things to do around that age where the region has them, and reading for it. Our own written guidance, with the pages it drew on.

region.description: Where the family lives and gets care. GB: the United Kingdom. US: the United States. TR: Türkiye. INTL: general guidance for every other country, such as Germany, India or Brazil. Required, with no default, because care differs between countries: guidance is never taken from another region.

age.description: The child's age, in the unit given (up to 6 years).

born_at_week.description: Only for a baby born before 37 weeks of pregnancy: the week they were born. The guide then follows their corrected age, as their care team does, until two years.

language.description: The language to answer in. If the region's guidance is not written in it, the region's own language is used (GB and US: en; TR: tr; INTL: en, tr, es, fr).
